g.text: The loop and weakening RO tendency are recovered; point-by-point agreement is incomplete.
Right: remove the fitted slope but retain the 1991–2020-referenced anomaly mean, then refit the same RO.
This shifts WWV by +0.238 SD and Niño3.4 by −0.016 SD; these are data-derived offsets, not corrections fitted to the image.
The manuscript does not specify the detrending intercept or normalization details. Neither convention is asserted to be the author’s.
Source panel: supplied manuscript.pdf, p. 11. Reconstruction uses the 19 event years shown in its Figure 4.
